OpenAI finds teen ChatGPT use poses 'unacceptable risk'

OpenAI has stated that while the use of ChatGPT by teenagers is limited, research indicates it presents an 'unacceptable risk'. The research found that crucial safety measures for teens using ChatGPT frequently failed.
